title: lounge chair cover
text: lounge chair cover. It's a bit bigger than it notes.. it doesn't really look like the photo as it doesn't really fit like that.  It is a stiffer plastic like material.  I think it may rip easily if not carefully looked after, HOWEVER... it's going to keep the rain off ... and the occasional bird dropping.  It has draw strings for the bottom that are SUPER hard to pull in... so unless you have the perfect sized chair (like the one they show in the photo) it's going to drag on the ground as my mine does.  I think it comes down to what you like and what bothers you.  In this case, it works, but it's not perfect in my opinion.

product_metadata.title: Abba Patio Outdoor/Pool Chaise Lounge Cover, Water Resistant, 84''L x 34''W x 34''H
